lines.say: Cells group into tissues, tissues into organs, and organs into systems.
Every cell keeps the whole genome. Differentiation changes which genes are switched on.
Dolly the sheep proved it. An adult nucleus could still build a whole animal.
Housekeeping genes are on in nearly every cell. Others are tissue specific.

draw.alt: Gene expression grid: gene 1 on in all cells, others in one each

lines.say: Test the DNA instead of mRNA, and all genes appear in all cells.
Cytoplasmic determinants are spread unevenly in the egg, so daughter cells differ.
Induction: signals from neighbouring cells change gene expression.
Transcription factors switch genes on or off. MyoD can push cells towards muscle.
Epigenetic marks, like DNA methylation, pack chromatin tightly and silence genes.
A cell becomes determined first, then fully differentiated.
Stem cells self renew and can differentiate.
To, Plu, Mul, Uni. From everything, down to one thing.

draw.alt: Potency ladder from totipotent down to unipotent

lines.say: Only totipotent cells, like the zygote, can also make the placenta.

draw.alt: Placenta ability lost going from totipotent to pluripotent

lines.say: Blood stem cells in bone marrow are multipotent. They make all blood cells.
iPS cells are adult cells reprogrammed to be pluripotent. No embryo needed.
But they carry a risk of forming tumours.

frames.heading: Four tissues: Every Cat Must Nap

lines.say: Epithelial, connective, muscle and nervous.
Epithelium is tightly packed, sitting on a basement membrane, with no blood vessels.
Name it by layers, then shape. One layer of tall cells is simple columnar.

draw.alt: Simple squamous, simple columnar and stratified squamous epithelium

lines.say: Connective tissue is a few cells in lots of matrix. Yes, blood counts.
Muscle is skeletal, cardiac or smooth. Cardiac cells join at intercalated discs.
Nervous tissue has neurones, plus glial cells that support them.
Plants grow from meristems, regions of dividing cells at tips and in stems.
Dermal tissue is the epidermis, with a waxy cuticle and guard cells.
Xylem is a dead drainpipe, hollow and lignified. It carries water up.

draw.alt: Dead hollow xylem tube beside living phloem with companion cell

lines.say: Phloem sieve tubes are living, kept going by companion cells. They carry sugars.
Ground tissue is parenchyma, collenchyma and sclerenchyma.
Specialised cells don't lose genes. They silence them.
Totipotent makes the placenta. Pluripotent doesn't.
Xylem conducting cells are dead. Phloem sieve tubes are alive.
Connective tissue isn't tightly packed. Epithelium is.
